summary: The root لسن (lisān) primarily refers to the tongue. However, it can also describe the projecting part of a sandal, the tongue of a balance, or even news/tidings.
lane: لِسَانٌ ذ of a sandal, The thing ( هَنَة ) projecting in the fore part thereof. (TA.) See مِسْرَدٌ . -b2- لِسَانٌ The tongue [or cock ] of a balance: see مِنْجَمٌ in the S and K. -b3- لِسَانٌ In formation, news, or tidings; syn. خَبَرٌ . (S in art. علو .) See a verse cited voce عُلْوٌ .

provenance.summary: Editorial summary derived from the Lane entry. NOT Lane's own wording. Shown as a gloss only; the Lane text below is the source.

headwords.def: لَسَنٌ Chasteness, or perspicuity, or clearness, of speech, (S, Msb, K,) and eloquence; (Msb;) i. q. بَيَانٌ: or, as some say, the quality of speaking well: and chasteness, or perspicuity, or eloquence, of speech, and sharpness of tongue. (TA.)

لِسَانٌ of a sandal, The thing ( هَنَة ) projecting in the fore part thereof. (TA.) See مِسْرَدٌ. لِسَانٌ The tongue [or cock ] of a balance: see مِنْجَمٌ in the S and K. لِسَانٌ In formation, news, or tidings; syn. خَبَرٌ. (S in art. علو.) See a verse cited voce عُلْوٌ.
مُلَسَّنٌ, (S,) or with ة, (K,) A sandal long and slender, like the form of the tongue: (S, K:) or having the extremity of its fore part like the extremity of the tongue. (TA.)

headword_note: Lane indexes geminate roots with two letters where the Corpus uses three; both spellings are resolved here.
mentions_note: Forms Lane discusses inside another entry rather than defining as a headword. Values index into headwords[].
